_about: Public-domain St Thérèse of Lisieux (1873-1897) in English for the Word Hoard: her Poems, tr. S. L. Emery (Boston, 1907), Sœur Thérèse of Lisieux, the Little Flower of Jesus, T. N. Taylor's complete translation of L'Histoire d'une Âme (Burns & Oates, imprimatur 1912), the Thoughts, translated by an Irish Carmelite (New York, 1915), and A Little White Flower, Taylor's new translation of the autobiography (1916), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

therese-poems-emery: Poems of Sr. Teresa, Carmelite of Lisieux, tr. S. L. Emery (Boston: Angel Guardian Press; copyright 1907)

therese-thoughts: Thoughts of the Servant of God Thérèse of the Child Jesus, translated by an Irish Carmelite (New York: P. J. Kenedy, 1915)
therese-little-white-flower: A Little White Flower: the story of Sœur Thérèse of Lisieux, a new translation by Thomas N. Taylor (preface dated March 1916)
